alate: Alate head deep brownish yellow, compound eyes blackish brown, ocelli, antennae and labrum yellowish brown, pronotum slightly paler than the head, abdomen and legs yellowish brown. Head elongate-oval; compound eyes also elongate-oval, their short diameter less than twice the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli spindle-shaped, their distance from the compound eye about half their short diameter. Antennae with eight segments, the specimen is broken, the second shortest. The width of the pronotum is about equal to that of the head (including the compound eyes).
soldier: The soldier has the head yellowish brown, the tips of the mandibles blackish brown, the labrum, antennae, thorax, abdomen and legs all paler than the head. Head cylindrical, about 1.1 times as wide as high, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. In profile the dorsal angle of the frons hardly raised, the frontal slope about 45 degrees, the dorsal margin of the head and the ventral margin of the postmentum nearly straight, the frontal surface flat, the anterior arm of the Y-shaped suture visible, ocelli not discernible, compound eyes recognisable. Labrum nearly circular, the tips of the mandibles slightly curved, the left mandible more than half as long as the head capsule. Antennae with 11 segments. The postmentum about six times as long as the width at the waist, the widest region in the anterior third of the mentum, the waist region near the posterior margin. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, about 2.5 times as wide as its median length, with a small notch in the middle of the anterior margin, the lateral margins rounded outwards, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave forwards.
